body.intent: Fix rhiza session message writes its file into the run's worktree, but verifiers and review checks run in detached checkouts under .git/rhiza/checkouts/, so the session is told to read a relative path that does not exist where it runs. On 2026-11-13 at 10:05Z, rhiza session message 4594e9fa (verifier of run 01M79TRE3W, cwd .git/rhiza/checkouts/01M79TRE3WM2X83PZ6TBWRQC3W-daemon-holds-steps-on-stale-guide-2) wrote /home/rhiza/code/rhiza.fix-runs-started-agent/.rhiza/local/messages/4594e9fa.../0001.md; the session answered 'I couldn't read the message. .rhiza/local/messages/.../0001.md doesn't exist' and went idle again. Worked around at 10:17Z by creating the file at the same relative path inside the checkout before sending the next message. Wanted: write the message file in the session's own working directory (its checkout), or give the pointer as an absolute path.
